$comment: Single source of truth for what αlphaβeta can do today. Consumed by the canvas (status chips + 'what's here' tray) and by the landing site (/capabilities page). Statuses: live = works end to end in the static build; partial = works with a stated gap; stub = placeholder with fixture data, visibly pencil-register; planned = listed only. Kinds follow shape/surfaces-v0.md — every surface is a place, a face, a moment, a document, a tray, or a lab tool. No fifth kind of screen.

surfaces.name: The Canvas
surfaces.note: goal → problem → question/solution → bet cascade; tree auto-layout; horizontal or vertical

surfaces.name: The Ledger
surfaces.note: table + kanban; filter by status, surface, instrument rung

surfaces.name: The Docket
surfaces.gap: maturation defaults to 14 days; no contention detection

surfaces.name: Solution admission
surfaces.note: grounds with provenance tiers, screens, rivals, arbitration — pencil register

surfaces.name: Bet, post-lock (cockpit)
surfaces.note: sealed commitment with compiled rules, seal re-verified on open, amendment timeline, guardrails, resolve entry

surfaces.name: Lock
surfaces.note: premortem; instrument rung sets the ceremony (fold-if / expectation / evidence bar); criteria prose kept, rules compiled; committed fields sealed

surfaces.name: Resolution
surfaces.note: bucket computed from the locked fold-if; deviation demanded when call ≠ bucket

surfaces.name: Amendment
surfaces.note: one field + reason, on the record

surfaces.name: Calibration mirror
surfaces.note: expected vs actual, Brier trend — needs resolved bets

surfaces.name: History scrubber
surfaces.note: needs the event log persisted, not board state

surfaces.name: Open Field (facilitator)
surfaces.gap: bring your own Anthropic key in the public build; the relay facilitator needs npm run dev

surfaces.name: Intake / residue
surfaces.gap: classifies by cues, doesn't converse — the facilitator is the conversational version

surfaces.name: Export / import board
surfaces.note: versioned envelope with migration chain; the precondition for keeping real bets here

surfaces.name: Sealed fingerprint
surfaces.gap: lock seals the committed fields (SHA-256) and the cockpit re-verifies; no shareable receipt yet

surfaces.name: Lock as bet (from the lab)
surfaces.note: app.alphabeta.tools/bet/new?from=<tool>&v=1&… mints a draft with the lab inputs on the instrument; supports sample-size (srm and detectable-lift are registered stubs that refuse rather than guess)

surfaces.name: Sample size
surfaces.question: How big does my test need to be?

surfaces.name: Detectable lift
surfaces.question: What can I detect with the traffic I have?

surfaces.name: Pre/post
surfaces.question: Did the change move the series?

surfaces.name: Sequential
surfaces.question: Can I peek, and when do I stop?

surfaces.name: Bayesian analysis
surfaces.question: How likely is the treatment better?
